verdict.rationale:
Semgrep rules can be configured to run automatically on events (push, PR/MR, pre-commit) and trigger downstream actions such as PR comments, alerts/notifications, ticket creation, and autofix application — all documented as first-class features (semgrep-docs-25/28/16/46/22/30/38/53/57). This directly matches the story of rules triggering automated actions on events.
missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence confirming these automated trigger-action pipelines (e.g., ticket creation, alerting) work reliably in production beyond vendor docs.
